arguments.content:
import os
import sys
import zipfile

src, dst = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as z:
    for name in z.namelist():
        target = os.path.join(dst, name)
        if name.endswith('/'):
            os.makedirs(target, exist_ok=True)
            continue
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(target), exist_ok=True)
        with z.open(name) as f, open(target, 'wb') as out:
            out.write(f.read())
print('unpacked to', dst)

import xml.dom.minidom as minidom

with open('unpacked/word/document.xml', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

dom = minidom.parseString(content)
with open('unpacked/word/document_pretty.xml', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(dom.toprettyxml(indent='  '))
print('pretty printed; bytes:', len(dom.toprettyxml(indent='  ')))

import os
import sys
import zipfile

src, dst = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
with zipfile.ZipFile(dst, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
    for root, _, files in os.walk(src):
        for f in sorted(files):
            full = os.path.join(root, f)
            rel = os.path.relpath(full, src)
            zf.write(full, rel)
print('packed to', dst)
